title: Standalone fixed-city ordinary personnel loyalty v1 JSON interchange structures
description: Closed structures for scenario, command envelope, successful receipt, saved state and typed replay trace. All policy values, source-boundary fields and embedded affinity evidence are fixed to this version. Runtime reconstruction is authoritative: schema conformance is neither evidence of original-game fidelity nor proof of reachable state, correct arithmetic, RNG progression, source provenance or passed execution checks. API result schemas are available in $defs. Non-JSON descriptor restrictions, duplicate textual JSON keys, negative zero, canonical ordering, cross-field references and complete byte/node/depth budgets require runtime enforcement. Individual collection and numeric maxima share total runtime budgets and are not guaranteed to be simultaneously attainable; the save-result budget includes the escaped canonical state JSON string in its result wrapper.
$comment: Use the root union for the five document kinds, or a specific #/$defs reference. Policy changes require a new version/ID. This schema is authored as documentation; it does not replace execute/load/replay recomputation.

symmetricRelation.description: Runtime normalizes each pair and rejects reverse duplicates and self-pairs.

relations.description: Membership, self-reference, normalized duplicate pairs, spouse/parent cardinality and ancestry cycles are enforced by runtime.

scenario.description: Initial scenario. Runtime checks the fixed identities, unique officer IDs, relation graph, date horizon and complete canonical scenario budget, then sorts the roster and relations. Creation does not settle the initial date again.

envelope.description: Cash target order is canonicalized by code-unit ID order. The canonical envelope, including expectedRevision, determines successful-command ID equality.

snapshot.description: Every value must equal runtime reconstruction. Cross-field equality, roster identity, sort order and reachability are not established by this structure.

scope.const: resolved unsigned affinity bytes; numerical return only

const.scope: resolved unsigned affinity bytes; numerical return only

affinityReceipt.description: Complete existing affinity numerical receipt. The new candidate adapter reads returnedAl, preserving the kernel evidence and all numerical outputs.

candidate.description: Null later branches record short-circuiting. Runtime recomputation determines consistency of reason, eligibility, evidence and evaluated branches.

loyaltyWrite.description: True loyalty is a 0..255 byte; displays are min(true,100). Arithmetic and requested/actual differences are recomputed by runtime.

officerReceipt.description: Cash and natural branch field consistency, current-turn qualification and praise changes are runtime assertions.

draw.description: One real call in the shared session-local stream. Runtime verifies transition, value, consecutive drawIndex, target order and label.

receipt.description: Successful derived receipt. Supplied receipts never drive computation; replay compares the entire recomputed value, including every policy/evidence field, draw and before/after snapshot.

state.description: Parsed save document. Runtime reconstructs from canonical genesis, re-executes each unique accepted envelope, validates every intermediate command-result and save-result budget, compares full receipts and final snapshot, and returns a new immutable state. The escaped JSON string inside SaveResult also counts toward the 8 MiB total result budget.

failure.description: Failure contains no state or successful receipt. index is the failing replay/accepted-history entry when applicable. Runtime failures do not consume command IDs, resources or random draws.

trace.description: Typed replay trace. Null expected fields disable only comparison; runtime still derives the outcome. Malformed-envelope defensive replay inputs are outside this typed JSON interchange schema, although runtime can record them as failures. Business failures and same-ID retries with valid envelopes are represented here.

json.description: Canonical JSON encoding of state. Runtime budgets the complete SaveResult after escaping this string inside its wrapper, and independently reconstructs the parsed state.
